Third-party notices
===================

libwing 1.0.6 (revision 36d713e), by Danny Firesnake
https://github.com/dannyfiresnake/libwing

WING Access includes a modified version of libwing and an adapted offline catalog.
Its license is included in libwing-LICENSE.txt and licenses/libwing/.

Modification notice:
- src/ffi.rs and libwing.h: additional application interface functions and
  corrected declarations.
- src/console.rs: connection handling, parameter encoding, validation and
  meter reception changes.
- Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock: dependency changes for the library build.

License and copyright notices for dependencies are included in
licenses/<crate-version>/. Rust runtime notices are in licenses/rust-runtime/.
These components retain their respective license terms and rights.
